name: ai4sgfinder
description: AI4SG Finder: choose the right AI-for-social-good allocation method.

plugins.name: ai4sg-finder
plugins.description: Diagnose an NGO or public-sector resource-allocation problem and recommend the appropriate AI-for-social-good approach (restless bandits, welfare ILP, security games, distributionally robust optimization, matching markets, participatory budgeting, effect-based targeting, adaptive experiments, vehicle routing, online assignment, network seeding or risk-based inspection), or say that no model is needed. Use when someone wants help choosing an algorithm or ML method for allocating aid, staff time, patrols, supplies, seats, inspections or a community budget; when a tool such as speech recognition, document extraction or a risk score is meant to feed such a decision; or when a funder wants to review an NGO proposal that uses a model or AI, including an AI tutor or adviser.
